title: Calibrated interval ranking
formal_object: Fixed teacher logits t_hat(q,c), simultaneous relevance intervals [t_hat-u,t_hat+u], and bilinear student w with training-only x=vec(q(c_pos-c_neg)^T)/T.
assumptions: Calibration establishes simultaneous interval coverage for all compared candidates, in the same teacher-logit units.
Calibration is independent of fitting/evaluation/confirmation; repeated deterministic logits alone are not a confidence interval.
lambda>0 and candidate pairs come only from released supervision.

operations.input: A teacher margin with two bounded error terms
Positive worst-case margin and convex student constraints
operations.output: Penalize only certified positive margins with convex hinge and anchored ridge.

derivation_steps.justification: Minimizing the difference over the rectangular joint interval takes the lower positive endpoint and upper negative endpoint.

derivation_steps.statement: m>0 implies positive teacher ordering only on the joint-coverage event.
derivation_steps.justification: Subtracting the two intervals preserves units; marginal calibration alone does not establish joint coverage.

derivation_steps.statement: L(w)=mean_[m>0] max(0,m-x^T w)+lambda||w-w0||^2/2; use its bounded-step subgradient.
derivation_steps.justification: The subgradient is -mean[x 1{x^T w<m}]+lambda(w-w0); optimization convergence is not a rank guarantee.

method_expression: Fit the certified-margin hinge with fixed training-only intervals and anchored ridge; block when no calibrated intervals or no eligible margins exist.
distinguishing_prediction: When simultaneous teacher-error bounds are valid, erroneous certified teacher ordering occurs only outside the declared coverage event; declining pair coverage trades supervision volume for conditional ordering reliability.
falsifier: Invalid coverage or no certified pairs defeats the premise. A matched point/logit KD solution with the same information and fitting cost removes the need for this intervention.
closest_alternative: Calibrated selective prediction/robust ranking and Qwen listwise distillation; C_KD is squared pairwise fitting and is not the complete strongest KD alternative.
decisive_comparison: On the published tasks retain all candidate rankings; compare interval vs point-supervised fitting under identical teacher/data/PCA and report genuine independent calibration coverage separately.
legacy_code_audit: Legacy fit(I01) uses the hinge but prepare_candidate_bundle sets interval_calibration=None. No executable independent interval producer or coverage evidence exists.
review_limit: Conditional identities reviewed; calibration, close-work functional audit, Parent/Gate0/IPCG remain pending.
